required_fields.required_artifacts: list[string] - Minimum required generated evidence artifacts
required_fields.required_blocking_gates: list[string|object] - Minimum required gates with blocking=true
required_fields.required_test_invariants: list[object] - Minimum required semantic invariant proofs
required_fields.required_protected_paths: list[object] - Minimum protected paths with must_exist specifications
required_fields.required_report_bindings: list[object] - Minimum bindings between report fields and raw evidence
required_fields.manifest_required: boolean - Enforces complete sealed bundle manifest
required_fields.status_ceiling: string - Maximum allowed status, strictly bounded to PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW
